verses.gurmukhi: ੨੦ : ਮਨਮੁਖ ਅੰਦਰਿ ਨੂੰ ਅਵਗੁਣ ਕਰਦਾ ਹੈ
verses.translit_en: 20 : manmukh a(n)dhar noo(n) avagun karadhaa hai

en.bdb: Manmukh returns evil for good done to him

verses.gurmukhi: ਥਲਾਂ ਅੰਦਰਿ ਅਕ ਉਗਵਨਿ ਵੁਠੇ ਮੀਂਹ ਪਵੈ ਮੁਹਿ ਮੋਆ।
verses.translit_en: thalaa(n) a(n)dhar ak ugavan vuThe mee(n)h pavai muh moaa|

en.bdb: Akk plant grows in sandy regions and during rain it falls on its face.

verses.gurmukhi: ਪਤਿ ਟੁਟੈ ਦੁਧ ਵਹਿ ਚਲੈ ਪੀਤੈ ਕਾਲਕੂਟ ਓਹੁ ਹੋਆ।
verses.translit_en: pat TuTai dhudh veh chalai peetai kaalakooT oh hoaa|

en.bdb: Milk oozes out of it when its leaf is plucked but it turns out to be poison when drunk.

verses.gurmukhi: ਅਕਹੁਂ ਫਲ ਹੁਇ ਖਖੜੀ ਨਿਹਫਲ ਸੋ ਫਲ ਅਕਤਿਡੁ ਭੋਆ।
verses.translit_en: akahu(n) fal hui khakhaRee nihafal so fal akatidd bhoaa|

en.bdb: The pod is a useless fruit of akk liked only by grasshoppers.

verses.gurmukhi: ਵਿਹੁ ਨਸੈ ਅਕ ਦੁਧ ਤੇ ਸਪੁ ਖਾਧਾ ਖਾਇ ਅਕ ਨਰੋਆ।
verses.translit_en: vih nasai ak dhudh te sap khaadhaa khai ak naroaa|

en.bdb: The poison gets diluted by akk-milk and (sometimes) a person bitten by sanke gets cured of its poison.

verses.gurmukhi: ਸੋ ਅਕ ਚਰਿ ਕੈ ਬਕਰੀ ਦੇਇ ਦੁਧੁ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤ ਮੋਹਿ ਚੋਆ।
verses.translit_en: so ak char kai bakaree dhei dhudh a(n)mirat moh choaa|

en.bdb: When a goat grazes the same akk,it yeilds nectar-like drinkable milk.

verses.gurmukhi: ਸਪੈ ਦੁਧੁ ਪੀਆਲੀਐ ਵਿਸੁ ਉਗਾਲੈ ਪਾਸਿ ਖੜੋਆ।
verses.translit_en: sapai dhudh peeaaleeaai vis ugaalai paas khaRoaa|

en.bdb: Milk given to snake is belched out by it instantly in the form of poison.
The wicked person returns evil for good done to him.
